title: Tetri-Shot Arcade Engine (Tetri-shot.lua)
description: A complete arcade puzzle shooter combining Tetris piece dropping and cursor-aimed piece shooting. Features screen shake, line-clearing particle explosions, panic bar countdown timer, and CW/CCW piece rotation via WASD/Click.

title: Chess Game (chess.lua)
description: A base for a chess game. Automatically instantiates 64 board tiles, rank and file coordinate indicators, and 32 unicode chess pieces with legal move validations, piece capture, turn toggling, and interactive click handling.

title: 2D Physics Pool Simulation (physics_parent.lua)
description: A full 2D billiards and physics particle engine with sub-stepping, circle-circle elastic collision resolution, table boundary friction, cue ball WASD steering, and cursor click explosion impulse.

title: Mario-like Platformer (platformer.lua)
description: A playable platformer level implementation featuring procedural level geometry, brick and bonus blocks with bouncing coins, walking/stompable enemies with squash tweens, momentum-based running and sprinting physics, camera scrolling, flagpole sequence, and timer HUD.

title: Minimal Lifecycle Starter (function OnStart().lua)
description: Clean starting point showing basic lifecycle callback implementation.
